words.meaning: People who followed Jesus so they could learn from Him and live the way He taught.
Blamed by someone for doing something wrong.
The things a person owns, like money, land, and goods.
A written report showing how someone handled money or property that was put in their care.
A person's job or role, the place they hold in someone's work.
People who owe something, such as money or goods, to someone else.

Set amounts used to count goods. Here the oil was counted in a unit of about 8 or 9 gallons, so a hundred of them was a huge amount. The wheat was counted in a much bigger unit, so a hundred of those was about 30 tons.
A grain a lot like wheat, grown for food and often made into bread.
A paper that writes down how much a person owes.
Things a person owes and has to pay back.
To praise someone or speak well of what they did.
Quick and clever at seeing what to do to come out ahead.
People who live only for this world and go by its ways.
People who belong to God and have been shown His truth.
Money and riches of this world, the kind people often chase and that does not last.
Homes that last forever, meaning a place with God in heaven.
The palace of a king along with the officials and helpers who serve there.
The hard, creamy white material from elephant tusks. It was costly and used to decorate rich people's houses.
Able to be trusted to do what you are supposed to do, again and again.
Buildings where grain and other goods are kept and saved up.
